name: PhotoDemon
description: Automatic self-updater downloads a .pdz2 over HTTPS from GitHub Pages and auto-executes a bundled PD_Update_Patcher.exe at shutdown; ExpectedChecksum defaults to skip — zero verification. Compromise of the GitHub Pages host = silent RCE.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: PhotoDemon’s package reader includes structural validation and conditional checksum handling. These facts do not establish independent publisher authentication or settle the original default-policy and impact claims.

original_evidence.text: | PhotoDemon | https://github.com/tannerhelland/PhotoDemon.git | 8357ce499 / 2026-08-18 | Y | Y (checked every session by default, `PDUF_EACH_SESSION`; user can set weekly/monthly/never) | **Y — fully automatic download + execute, no user confirmation required at the download/patch-apply step** | https to `tannerhelland.github.io` (GitHub Pages; `pdDownload.ctl` uses WinHTTP-backed async download — no TLS-bypass code found anywhere in repo) | N (plain HTML page on GitHub Pages with `<a id="pdv_*_start/end">` tag markers, not signed) | **none** — the update-package download call passes no `checksumToVerify` argument (defaults to 0 = skip), so the only integrity mechanism the codebase supports (`pdDownload.ExpectedChecksum`, a non-cryptographic checksum) is never applied to the `.pdz2` update package itself | n/a (no signing key of any kind used for the self-update payload) | `Modules/UpdateEngine.bas:315,331,334` (`updateURL = "https://tannerhelland.github.io/PhotoDemon-Updates-v2/auto/" & track & ".pdz2"`; `FormMain.RequestAsynchronousDownload("PD_UPDATE_PATCH", updateURL, PD_PATCH_IDENTIFIER, vbAsyncReadForceUpdate, ...)` — **no checksum arg passed**), `:350-400` (`PatchProgramFiles()` extracts embedded `PD_Update_Patcher.exe` from the downloaded package and calls `ShellExecuteW` on it with no signature/hash check), `Controls/pdDownload.ctl:117-118,245-259` (`ExpectedChecksum As Long` — defaults 0 = "checkSumPassed" defaults TRUE / skipped), `Forms/MainWindow.frm:2630-2643` (`AsyncDownloader_FinishedOneItem` → on `PD_PATCH_IDENTIFIER` success calls `Updates.NotifyUpdatePackageAvailable`, which is applied automatically at next shutdown with no further gating). **Plugin/filter channel note:** PhotoDemon also supports loading native Photoshop-compatible `.8bf` filter plugins via a bundled `pspiHost.dll` (`Modules/Plugin_Management.bas:751`, `Forms/Effects_8bf.frm`) and ships UI text claiming it will "download and configure" optional codec libraries (libavif, libheif, etc.) on demand (`Forms/Tools_PluginManager.frm:731`), but no wired-up network-fetch call site for these optional DLLs was found in this snapshot — `GetPluginHomepage()`/`GetPluginLicenseURL()` only populate hyperlink controls pointing to the upstream project pages for manual user download, reusing none of the update-package download path. |
